project_record_policy_content:
# Project record policy

When implementation is complete but a historical delivery link is stale, preserve the historical comment, add exactly one corrective note identifying the pull request and commit that actually delivered the implementation, remove `linkage-audit`, and leave valid issue lifecycle state and implementation history unchanged. Do not reopen completed work merely to repair provenance metadata.
